coverage.scope: British Standards and UK-adopted EN/IEC standards relevant to this fire and security manual archive, with supporting lighting, electrical and building-fire-safety references. PD 6662 and PD 6669 are explicitly labelled companion Published Documents.
limits: This is a checked register, not a complete catalogue of every British Standard or every historical amendment.
Edition headings and publisher statuses are verified against public BSI records. Detailed changes are summarized only where the publisher supplies a public summary.
An A-number in a designation records that amendment; it is not a complete list of earlier amendments or separate corrigenda.
A publisher record date can refer to a corrected issue or product record and can differ from the year in the designation. It is not an effective or withdrawal date.
Under review does not mean withdrawn. Drafts do not replace published standards. A newer edition does not establish a withdrawal date for an earlier one.
Full standard texts require the publisher licence. Offline search stores this metadata and these original short summaries, not licensed standards PDFs.
remaining_checks: Complete amendment, corrigendum and supersession histories from publisher history panels or licensed copies, especially EN 54 product standards.
Remaining EN 54 parts and PD CEN/TS application guides; remaining EN 50131 detector/application parts and EN 50130 environmental/EMC standards.
Remaining EN 60839 and EN 62820 application/interoperability parts; remaining EN 62676 protocol parts.
Supporting structured-cabling, social-alarm, fire-suppression and powered-gate references beyond the entries checked here.
Formal withdrawal/coexistence dates where BSI still shows both earlier and newer records as current; do not infer a deadline.
